input.brief: AlpenGuard: light, crisp winter-mountain safety assistant for ski tourers; one 3D map that crosses the avalanche bulletin, slope angles and foreign-language climber reports, plus an overdue alert to your contacts

direction.name: The place carries it
direction.idea: For a place, the photograph is the argument. One full-bleed image of where you would be standing fills the first screen, and the design steps back: the name sits along the bottom edge like a film title, or small in a corner, and nothing else interrupts the view. The page that follows keeps that restraint: few words, large pictures, long pauses. The designer's work here is editing: choosing the one frame that makes someone want to be there, and then not covering it.
direction.composition: First screen: a single photograph at 100vw by 100svh, focal point kept clear of text. The name is set either very large (14–20vw) hugging the bottom edge with 16–24px of margin, or small (20–28px) top-left with a one-line description bottom-left. Navigation is two to four words in the top corners in the same small size. If text sits on the image, a soft neutral scrim under the text area only. Below, sections alternate between a short centred or left-set paragraph in a narrow column (max 52ch) with wide empty margins, and photographs shown large: one full-bleed, then a pair at different sizes, then one portrait offset to the right. Practical information (hours, address, rates, booking) is gathered once near the end in a plain two-column block.
direction.typography: A face with some grace for the name; small, calm, well-spaced text everywhere else. Sentence case. Body 17–19px with leading around 1.55.
direction.colour: Neutral paper or deep neutral ground chosen to flatter the photographs; text ink drawn from the darkest tone in the imagery. Colour lives in the pictures.
direction.imagery: The dealt set is the palette. Choose four to six photographs with the same light. The hero image must have a calm area for the name. Full-bleed or large with square corners; never thumbnails, never a carousel of ten.
direction.photoTreatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.
direction.richness: The photographs, at full size, uninterrupted. Empty paper around short text makes the next image land harder.
direction.pitfalls: A weak hero photograph cannot be fixed by typography; pick again. Do not stack a headline, a paragraph and two buttons on the image. Do not use a booking bar that covers the bottom of the view; one small action is enough.

hero.name: Film title, bottom edge
hero.blueprint: One photograph fills the viewport at 100vw by 100svh, `object-fit: cover`, with its subject in the upper two-thirds and a calmer, darker zone along the bottom. The name is one condensed uppercase word, or a short name in a high-contrast serif, set at clamp(150px, 17.5vw, 290px) and sized to span the full width between 32px margins. It is centred and anchored so its baseline sits 34px above the bottom edge, covering roughly the lowest quarter of the frame. A soft neutral dark scrim lies under that bottom band only, about 40% of the height; the rest of the image is untouched. Directly above the name's left end, on the same margin, sits the supporting sentence at 16px on two short lines. Directly above its right end, right-aligned, sits the single action as a small paper-coloured rectangular button. The top edge carries a small emblem or wordmark at the left margin and up to five text links at 15px grouped at the right, all in white. The central half of the screen belongs to the view.
hero.mobile: The photograph is re-cropped to portrait with `object-position` on its subject and fills 100svh. The name stays on the bottom edge at 22vw on one line, or two lines at 20vw beyond eight characters, 20px above the edge. The supporting sentence sits above the name's left end at 15px. The action button moves to the top-right corner and the links collapse to a menu word beside the emblem.
hero.headline: The name of the place: one word of up to about 12 characters at 17.5vw, or two words stacked on a phone.

type.name: Newsreader

display.settings: weight 300 with optical sizing on · tracking -0.05em · leading 0.9 · sentence case at 12–14vw; chapter headings drop to the text weight at about 30px

type.note: One news serif with optical sizes: light and very tight when huge, open and bookish at 18px. Suits long-form stories, culture pieces, journals and research write-ups.

palette.name: Putty and black
palette.note: Warm putty covers the page and pure black handles all type and the main shapes. The only tint in the interface is teal, used for the one button or a single marker placed near the photographs.

photos.title: Mountain
photos.note: peaks, alpine valleys, snow and rock
photos.treatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.

photos.alt: Snow-covered peak rising above dark forested slopes and a lake
Snowy mountain peak framed by dark pine trees in mist
Layered mountain slopes fading into blue haze
Layered blue mountain ridges receding into haze
Rocky ridges and snow-covered peaks in a high mountain range
Snowy mountain peak behind a snow slope under pink-tinted clouds
Hazy mountain gorge with steep slopes in black and white
Green mountain streaked with snow rising above a dark gravel plain

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Right-half paragraph, lone photo
sections.blueprint: No heading. On a 12-column grid with 5vw margins, one statement paragraph of 45–70 words occupies columns 7–12 only, set at clamp(24px, 2.2vw, 34px) with leading 1.25 and a first-line indent of 3em. Its top edge sits 18vh below the section top. Columns 1–6 stay empty except for a single square photograph, 20vw wide, in columns 1–3, placed so its top aligns with the paragraph's last line and it hangs below the text by most of its height. A five-line note at 14px, 180px wide, sits in columns 1–2, 96px beneath the photograph. Section padding is 160px top and bottom. Nothing is centred: the paragraph's left edge is the midpoint of the page, and later text blocks on the page may reuse that line. Holds one paragraph, one photograph and one note.
sections.mobile: The paragraph comes first at 22px, full width with 20px margins and no indent. The photograph follows at 62% width, pushed to the right margin, in a 4:5 crop instead of square. The small note sits to its left, bottom-aligned with the photograph, in the remaining 30% of the width.

sections.name: One verb at a time
sections.blueprint: Three to five full-bleed panels, each 100svh tall, stacked with no gap; each is one stage and holds one photograph covering it. In every panel a single word, the verb for that stage ('Cut', 'Fold', 'Stitch', 'Press'), is set at clamp(96px, 17vw, 300px), heavy and centred, inside a wrapper that is position: sticky; top: 50% and shifted up by half its own height. Because each word is sticky only within its own panel, it holds the centre of the screen while its photograph passes behind it, and is then pushed out by the next panel's verb. Use mix-blend-mode: difference in white, or one solid colour tested on every image. One sentence at 18px sits in the bottom-left corner of each panel over a neutral scrim limited to that corner. There is no separate heading: the verbs, read in order, are both the heading and the sequence.
sections.mobile: Panels stay 100svh, each photograph cropped to a vertical slice. The verb is 24vw, still sticky at the centre. The sentence sits along the bottom over a scrim at 16px, full width with 16px margins.

sections.name: Cards crossing a held photograph
sections.blueprint: A wrapper about 350svh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh. On the stage one full-bleed photograph of the subject's ground (a landscape, a material, an aerial texture) stays still, darkened evenly with `filter: brightness(0.6)`. Over it a track of four to six cards travels from right to left as the page scrolls (a `translateX` tied to the wrapper's scroll progress), so one card is always near the centre and the next shows about 300px at the right edge. Each card is 720×560px, square corners, vertically centred with 170px of photograph above and below it: its top 68% is a photograph of one item (a room, a building, a stop on the route), its lower 32% a flat panel in one earth tone from the palette, a different tone per card at a similar lightness, holding the item's name at clamp(32px, 3vw, 48px) bottom-left with 28px padding and a two-line description at 16px right-aligned beside it. Cards are 40px apart. The section heading, two to four words at clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 68px) in the paper colour, sits top-left on the stage over the photograph before the first card arrives and moves out ahead of it. Keep the run under three screens; at its end the stage releases into the next section.
sections.mobile: No pin and no sideways travel. The photograph runs full-bleed as a 4:5 band under the heading at 9vw, and the cards follow it at full width minus 16px margins, 24px apart, each a 4:3 photograph over its colour panel 140px tall, with the name at 26px and the description at 16px.

sections.name: Rows with margin photographs
sections.blueprint: Everything hangs from one vertical axis at column 5, about 35% of the width. First the heading: a statement of up to five words at clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px) starting on the axis, vertically centred in an otherwise empty 70svh of ground. Then four or five benefit rows, each starting on the same axis: a title at clamp(28px, 3vw, 48px) and under it a paragraph of 34ch at 17px. Columns 1–4 stay empty. At the right margin each row carries one photograph, top-aligned with its title and deliberately unequal: 240px wide at 4:5 in one row, 320px at 3:2 in the next, 180px square after that. Rows are separated by 96–120px of space, not lines. On a saturated field, set all type in one pale ink and leave the photographs ungraded.
sections.mobile: The axis collapses to the left margin. The statement sits at 9vw in 50svh of empty ground. Each row stacks its title at 26px, the paragraph, then its photograph at alternating widths: 100%, 70% flush right, 55% flush left. 64px between rows.

sections.name: Wide photo, colour tile, facts
sections.blueprint: Top: a heading of two to four words at clamp(40px, 4vw, 60px) on the left margin, then 24px below it a three-line lead paragraph at 21–22px across columns 1–6. 72px lower, two tiles sit side by side with a 16px gap. The left tile spans columns 1–8: a landscape photograph at 16:10 with one radius (0 or 10px). A short paragraph of up to 35 words at 16px is set in a solid paper-colour block 320px wide with 20px padding, placed over the photograph's top-right corner and flush with both edges. The right tile spans columns 9–12 and is a flat palette colour, 60% of the photograph's height: it holds a simple inline SVG outline of the region or the floor plan as one filled shape, with one solid dot marking the location. Under the colour tile, four label and value pairs at 14px in a two-by-two grid: altitude, distance, season, local time.
sections.mobile: Heading at 9vw, lead at 18px. The photograph goes full width at 4:3 and its overlaid paragraph moves beneath it as ordinary text. The colour tile follows at full width and 3:2, and the four label and value pairs sit under it in two columns.

sections.name: Statement, table pushed right
sections.blueprint: A heading of four to six words spans the full width on two lines at clamp(40px, 4.5vw, 68px), left-aligned with its first line indented 3vw and leading 0.98. 96px below, the table is pushed into the right-hand five columns (8–12) and the left stays open. One plain word naming the table (offices, hours, rates) hangs at 14px in column 7, top-aligned with the first row. Each row is a three-part line at 15–16px with 26px between rows: the kind or day in the soft ink at the left of the measure, the place or service at 30%, and the address, time or price right-aligned, with a small arrow where the row links. Rows are separated by space only; every fourth row has 44px above it to form groups. In columns 1–4, bottom-aligned with the last row, one 4:5 photograph 22vw wide may sit alone. Holds 5–14 rows.
sections.mobile: Heading at 9.5vw without the indent. The table takes the full width at 16px; each row stacks the kind above the place, with the value right-aligned on the first line. The naming word is dropped because the heading already says it. The photograph follows at 60% width on the right margin.

sections.name: Questions beside a tall photograph
sections.blueprint: One field in a deep or pale flat tone, split 5 to 7. Left, columns 1–5: a heading of two to four words at 36–44px; under it the three or four practical facts people ask first (address, times, how to arrive) as plain lines at 18px; then five or six questions as an accordion with no lines between rows, only 28px of space. Each question is a `<summary>` at 20px with a small chevron drawn from two 2px strokes at its right; the open answer sits beneath at 17px in the softer ink, on the same left edge. One filled button and one text link close the column. Right, columns 7–12: a tall photograph (3:4) that bleeds off the top edge of the section and stops 80px short of the bottom, with a second, square photograph a third of its width overlapping its lower-left corner by 40px.
sections.mobile: The tall photograph leads at full width, 4:5, with the square one overlapping its bottom-right corner at 38% width. Heading at 30px, facts at 17px, then the accordion at full width with 24px between questions and 44px touch targets. Button full width at the end.

sections.name: The back of the card
sections.blueprint: The footer is the reverse side of the page's artefact, laid out as the back of a postcard. A paper-coloured panel spans columns 2–11 on the contrasting ground, about 420px tall, its top edge cut into a row of twelve semicircular scallops (an inline SVG path or `clip-path`, each scallop about 100px wide). The panel is divided by space into two halves. Left half: a short sign-off of two to four words at 32px, then two or three lines at 16px, written like a message. Right half: the address block, four left-aligned lines at 18px with 12px between them, each line a link (email, telephone, street, social); above it in the top-right corner, a stamp: one small photograph, 3:4 and 88px wide, with a 6px paper-coloured margin. Along the panel's bottom edge, a single centred line at 12px gives the copyright like a printer's imprint.
sections.mobile: The panel runs full width with six scallops across its top edge. The stamp sits top-right at 64px wide; the sign-off and message come first, then the address lines at 17px beneath them, then the imprint line centred at 12px.

references.name: White Desert
references.idea: One word, the destination, set a third of the screen tall over footage like a film title card; sheer scale stands in for remoteness.
references.hero: Full-bleed video (the view from an aircraft window over an ice shelf, darkly vignetted by the window frame) fills the viewport. Faint vertical hairlines divide it into six columns. Top-left, three outlined rectangular nav buttons about 120 by 40px with 6px gaps; top-right, two more; between them a small white mountain logo over a condensed caps name. One condensed uppercase word spans almost the full width at 17.8vw, white, centred, anchored so its baseline sits about 35px above the bottom edge. At mid-height a two-line italic serif tagline at about 16px hangs on the first column line at left, and a film-play label sits between two hairlines at right.
references.type: Three voices: Oswald 400 uppercase for the giant word and footer wordmark (up to 22vw); Cardinal Classic Long, a light high-contrast serif, for caps statements near 32px and italic taglines; Inter Tight 14px for nav and body. Body to display is roughly an 18x jump.
references.colour: #040608 #ffffff #e9e7e1 #1f2b4d #f5821f #95979a — Footage and near-black open the page; content sections flip to pure white with navy serif type and end on a warm grey footer. One small orange tab is the only accent. Cool overall.
references.imagery: Aerial and wildlife footage and stills of ice, penguins and rust-coloured rock peaks, natural cool grade, always full-bleed with square corners; trips appear as tall vertical image slices set side by side with no gaps.
references.layout: A six-column grid made visible by faint full-height hairlines runs through every section. Text blocks are small and hung off column lines, often starting at column two or three, with large voids around them. Full-bleed image screens alternate with nearly empty white text screens.

sections.description: A white screen with the six vertical hairlines still showing. A serif caps paragraph at about 32px, navy, light weight and tight leading, occupies only columns two to four, left-aligned with its first line indented by half the measure. Above its top-left sits a small italic label ringed by a loose hand-drawn pen scribble. An orange vertical tab with rotated text is fixed to the right edge.

Leaving the hero, the giant word blurs and dissolves into white mist that becomes the next section's background. Later a full-viewport photograph of jagged rock peaks in snow bleeds to all four edges, with a narrow 13px paragraph from the white section above overlapping its top edge at a column line, so text and image interlock rather than stack.

A serif caps heading at about 40px sits left of centre with a long pencil-like scribble underline that extends well past the words on both sides. Below, a full-width band of four vertical image panels with no gaps and unequal widths, like an accordion; the first panel carries a two-line italic serif title in white at its top-left.

Warm grey field. The top row holds a small logo, three columns of grey link lists with italic serif group headings and, at right, a stack of square-cornered off-white tiles (a video thumbnail, two half-width buttons, one full-width). Beneath, the brand name in navy condensed caps runs edge to edge at about 22vw. A final strip has award badges left, a centred italic quotation and legal links right.

steal: Set a single place name in condensed caps at about 18vw, centred and anchored to the bottom edge of full-bleed footage, with everything else on screen at 14-16px.
Leave the column grid visible as faint full-height hairlines across video, white and footer sections, and hang small text blocks off those lines.
Ring or underline small serif labels with a loose hand-drawn pen scribble to put one human mark into an otherwise strict layout.
references.media: An 18s muted aerial and ice-cave clip covers the whole first screen under a scrim, with the title docked along the bottom edge. Later pictures dissolve into the white page through fog-like fades, a horizontal accordion opens one trip panel at half width beside blurred slivers, vertical ice strips wipe across the previous photograph, and a long pinned track of inset cards floats on a full-bleed texture ground before a closing photo panel carrying a quotation; 20 images, one video, square corners and a high-key cold grade.
references.motion: There is no entrance choreography and footage plays from the first frame; under Lenis the hero title blurs and is swallowed by a sticky fog layer growing from 390 to 900px tall, statement lines fill from grey to navy, the camps heading scrubs from 140px down to 60px, and a pinned horizontal track moves the cards at about 0.56px per scrolled pixel over an 8,328px runway. Blocks rise 20rem with opacity over 1.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), and hovers run .3s cubic-bezier(.5,1,.89,1).

references.name: Seasats
references.idea: Calm, dusk-lit seascapes sell autonomous boats as serene instruments, and the navigation is a column of stacked colour swatches taken from that sea-and-sand palette.
references.hero: A 10px white frame surrounds everything. The left 84% is one rounded media panel: a dusk scene of a low, solar-decked vessel centred on mirror-flat water, with two larger hulls cropped by the panel's left and right edges. The headline is centred in the panel's upper third, two lines of white light-weight flared serif at 124px (8.6vw). A wordmark in custom wide techno lettering sits top-left; a white rounded button with mono caps and a dark-green square arrow sits bottom-centre. The right 14% is the menu: a full-height column of stacked flat colour blocks (blush, sage, then four darkening olives), each holding left-aligned 15px links, sub-items numbered 01 to 04.
references.type: seasonMix, a low-contrast serif-sans hybrid, light weight, sentence case, near-zero tracking, at 124px for the headline and about 40px for statements; seasonSans 16px for body and menu; supplyMono uppercase at 9 to 12px for buttons, tags and footer data.
references.colour: #a6b3bc #232323 #b7c8be #d6c4b8 #2c3620 #e2832a — Slate blues and lilac greys from the seascapes dominate; the menu adds blush, sage and olive blocks; the footer flips to a burnt-orange and rust scene. Text stays white.
references.imagery: Photoreal rendered footage of autonomous boats on glassy water at dusk: symmetrical, low horizon, lots of sky, full-bleed after the hero. Small square-cornered inset stills with mono tag labels float over the scene.
references.layout: Mostly full-viewport scenes with one centred text block each, at top or bottom, and the wordmark fixed top-left. Only the hero uses the framed panel-plus-menu split. A thin vertical progress line runs down the right edge.

sections.description: A pinned full-bleed scene shot from the boat's deck: the hull forms a dark symmetrical wedge rising from the bottom edge to a mast at centre, horizon at one-third. At top-centre six short statements are stacked, centred, at 16px; one is white and the others half opacity, and the highlight steps down the list on scroll. For each, small photo cards (150 to 220px wide, square corners, mono tag on the top edge) appear left and right of the mast.

A full-bleed aerial view of dark teal water with several small vessels scattered across the lower half and a faint horizon near the top. A single two-line statement in the light serif at about 40px sits centred near the bottom edge. Nothing else is on screen except the wordmark top-left and the thin progress line at right.

Colour inverts to a burnt-orange haze over rust-red terrain, with black silhouettes of hulls and a keel hanging from the top edge as if seen from below the surface. Mid-height: mono readouts at left reporting distance scrolled in metres and scroll speed in knots with a one-line quip; a link list at 16px in the centre; mono contact details at right. The wordmark fills the full width at the bottom, white, about 130px tall.

steal: Build the menu as a full-height column of stacked flat colour blocks sampled from the imagery, grouping links by block colour instead of by rules or headings.
List every claim at once, centred and dimmed, and move a single full-opacity highlight through the list on scroll while supporting images appear around a fixed subject.
Give the footer its own opposite-temperature scene and a live readout of how far and how fast the visitor scrolled, in the product's own units.
references.media: A dusk render of the vessel on still water, as a still, a 3s muted loop and a canvas layered together, fills an inset card at about 84% of the width beside a colour-band nav panel and goes full bleed once scrolled. Then a scroll-scrubbed frame sequence on a sticky stage with labelled photo cards floating at depth, small video thumbnails that grow into full-bleed chapter loops, a WebGL globe rising as a half-sphere from the bottom edge, and sticky product renders that turn with the scroll; 18 images, 6 videos, 8px corners on the hero frame and cards.
references.motion: The preloader wordmark's seven letters slide up out of their masks at 50ms steps, the framed hero arrives at 1.2s and the title fades in softly, settling after about 5s, and smooth scroll then runs 34 sticky elements with no pins: the flythrough is a scrubbed image sequence, a fixed background layer changes the ground per chapter, and the nav collapses to a slim right-edge rail. Title characters rise on cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1) (the house ease, 17 uses) with durations that shorten by 12ms per character, so the end of a word catches up with its start.

references.name: The state of the gallery
references.idea: A year-in-review told as a flight over a glowing particle landscape, where each statistic or pick is a single word floating in 3D space.
references.hero: The desktop capture caught the loader: a blue-black screen with a faint dot grid, a 4px acid-yellow progress bar across the top edge, the small logo centred at the top, and a percentage counter at 13.9vw (200px) in thin pale blue-grey grotesk anchored bottom-left. The loaded hero, seen on mobile, splits the title in two: the first two words top-left and the last three bottom-right at the same giant size, with a centred uppercase paragraph between them, all over a full-bleed terrain of olive-green haze and yellow particles. Tiny capital labels occupy all four corners.
references.type: Overused Grotesk only, regular weight: display words at 5 to 14vw in pale blue-grey with a faint lilac sheen, small parenthesised counts set as superscripts beside them, and 10px uppercase captions and corner labels. Two sizes and no bold.
references.colour: #08090d #515721 #b9c6cd #e6f21a #c8b9ee — Blue-black ground; the olive-to-acid-yellow glow of the particle field is the single colour. Type is cool pale grey with a lilac tint, and the yellow loader bar is the brightest element.
references.imagery: A procedural landscape of soft olive fog ridges with thousands of yellow-white points streaming toward the horizon in perspective; later, a curved floor of small tilted white tiles standing for catalogued sites. No photographs.
references.layout: One pinned canvas with a text overlay. Four corner labels stay fixed; each scroll step puts a single word or name at the centre with a one-line caption beneath it in the lower third. Nothing else appears on screen.

sections.description: Full-bleed particle terrain. One category word is centred at about 5vw in pale iridescent grotesk, with its count in parentheses set small and raised at the word's top-right like a superscript. A single-line uppercase caption at 10px sits centred roughly 20% below. Behind the word the particles briefly cluster into the shape of a large numeral. Corner labels are unchanged.

A top-pick slide: a tiny uppercase label above, then the pick's name centred at about 5vw and partly occluded by the scene. Below it dozens of small white rectangular tiles lie on a curved, receding floor grid, some flat and some tilting up toward the camera, growing larger toward the bottom edge of the viewport. A one-line caption sits under the name.

steal: Split a title in two and pin the halves to opposite corners, top-left and bottom-right, at the same giant size with the supporting paragraph centred between them.
Attach a count to a big word as a small parenthesised superscript at its top-right instead of building a stat card.
Make the loading percentage the first giant typographic element, anchored bottom-left under a full-width accent progress bar.
references.media: One fixed WebGL canvas is the only surface: a particle landscape covers 99% of the first screen with the title straight on it, and as you travel the particles leave the ground to form numerals, a figure, floating screenshot cards and a tile-grid panel, while streams of thumbnail tiles fly low between beats. No img or video elements.
references.motion: A percentage preloader is still at 89% at 4.5s, though the load event fired at 2.1s; after it the wheel is captured, each step easing the camera forward to the next beat, with text-free fly-through steps between them (5 of 13 screens show only terrain). Characters rise with a stagger, transform and opacity over 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) on 704 spans, 0.42s for secondary lines, and counts pop in with an overshoot from 0.6 to 1.08 to 1.
